content:
As far as I know about Tawil and the main story (which I just finished chapter 7 in Arc 1 by the time I'm writing this), their interaction would be really rare. If any opportunity arose, Mira would've asked a lot of questions, including if there was a way that she would've prevented from her family's tragic fate from happening in the first place.

With Hameln, on the other hand, I can see Mira helping him with creating lyrics for his songs if asked, considering she writes poems during her spare time. Though I know their session would be a long one, knowing how much of the perfectionist he is.
-# For some reason, I can also see Hameln using her Morse Key to create music.
-# No, I am not basing it on how Joel Sunny made some of the music with Morse Codes, what are you talking about? /sarcasm
